policy.multipleIncoming: Root approved; record old parent and add secondary binding without deleting it.
policy.canonicalClaims: direct-canon means an official source explicitly permits or states the relationship in its own profile/card context. It never means exclusive canon or exact World DS rules.
policy.prototypeGates: All level/bond requirements here are authored; official card costs are not translated into game stats.
policy.fusionAndVariants: Existing fusion shortcuts are flagged; new special conversions require explicit approval rather than inventing missing mechanics.

proposedEdges.reason: Continue the GeoGreymon family into the listed RizeGreymon. The official card game explicitly names GeoGreymon as a digivolution source; prototype XP/bond gates remain our own.

primarySupport.supports: Official RizeGreymon card explicitly permits digivolution from GeoGreymon.

proposedEdges.reason: Continue the musical amphibian family. The ShogunGekomon profile directly compares its voice and social bearing with Gekomon; it does not specify a game evolution requirement.

primarySupport.supports: Names Gekomon while describing the more powerful musical Ultimate.

proposedEdges.reason: The official profile expressly calls SuperStarmon the Ultimate form of Starmon.
Use the established Numemon-to-Monzaemon transformation as a positive, elective progression. Do not add care-punishment or costume inventory conditions.

primarySupport.supports: Official Monzaemon card explicitly names Numemon as its digivolution source.
Confirms the mysterious Puppet identity, but does not identify the occupant.

proposedEdges.reason: Join the two flightless plant-bird forms. Deramon's official profile explicitly compares its plant qualities and inability to fly with Kiwimon; the precise parent assignment is inferred.

primarySupport.supports: Explicit comparison to Kiwimon and Ultimate evolution, without an exclusive parent claim.

proposedEdges.reason: An authored vegetation route from the tendril-bearing plant Champion to the flower-and-tentacle Ultimate. Official profiles establish the shared plant theme, not a direct evolution edge.

primarySupport.supports: Champion Vegetation identity and vine-based body.
Ultimate Vegetation identity, flowers and tentacles.

proposedEdges.reason: Add the familiar SkullGreymon branch while preserving Greymon-to-MetalGreymon. The player chooses it normally; the prototype must not require neglect, death, or a care mistake.

primarySupport.supports: Official deck instructions explicitly progress Greymon into SkullGreymon.
Describes the Undead Ultimate; no prototype punishment mechanic is inferred.

proposedEdges.reason: Add the blue MegaKabuterimon branch while keeping the existing red branch. The blue profile explicitly states that it digivolved from Kabuterimon.

primarySupport.supports: Explicit Kabuterimon predecessor for the Blue variant.

proposedEdges.reason: Carry the sword-focused Kotemon/Dinohyumon branch into a blade-bodied Ultimate. This is a curated combat-theme continuation, not a claim that the encyclopedia or World DS lists this exact gate.

primarySupport.supports: Dinohyumon is a sword- and arm-blade-equipped warrior.
Kyukimon is a fast, blade-covered beast with cutting attacks.

proposedEdges.reason: BlackRapidmon's profile states that it is Rapidmon altered by ingesting Black Digitron. Offer this only as an explicitly authored one-way variant conversion; ordinary level/bond alone does not reproduce that lore condition.

primarySupport.supports: Explicit Rapidmon-to-BlackRapidmon change via Black Digitron.

unimplementedConditions: Black Digitron ingestion is not implemented; if merged, label the level/bond conversion as a prototype shortcut.

proposedEdges.reason: Allow the blue MegaKabuterimon branch to reach the existing HerculesKabuterimon without removing the red branch. The official profile describes combined Kabuterimon/Kuwagamon data and a previous MegaKabuterimon state; it does not identify an exclusive color predecessor.

primarySupport.supports: Combined Kabuterimon/Kuwagamon data and prior MegaKabuterimon flight ability.
Blue is itself a Kabuterimon digivolution.

unimplementedConditions: No second companion, fusion consumption, or data-combination mechanic is implemented.

proposedEdges.reason: Continue Dinobeemon into GranKuwagamon while preserving Okuwamon's existing route. The official card explicitly names Dinobeemon; this does not assert World DS's original requirements.

primarySupport.supports: BT16-046 GranKuwagamon ACE explicitly names Dinobeemon as a digivolution source.

proposedEdges.reason: Continue the Lalamon/Sunflowmon/Lilamon family into the existing Rosemon while preserving Lillymon's existing route. Official ST24-11 explicitly names Lilamon.

primarySupport.supports: Official Rosemon ST24-11 explicitly names Lilamon as a digivolution source.
